Settings

Profiles, memory, consent, and safety.
About inCommon
inCommon is spirituality as spirituality intended; here, you are more than you knew you were. Our faith is in your ability to absorb what your potential might be, through the tools we have provided. We do not claim to be a replacement for professional help. If you find yourself in a crisis situation, please refer to our comprehensive list of hotlines available to the public in our Self Help Yellow Pages. Your experience is the final authority. Every claim is tagged by kind; memory is opt-in per source and lives on this device; a deterministic safety gate runs before any reading is generated; humans beat readings, every time. Here, everyone has something in common.
